abstract.p: Multi-task data matching-including entity matching, entity linking, and schema matching-is a fundamental task in data integration, yet remains challenging due to heterogeneous inputs and task-specific model designs. We propose Token-Fusion, a unified sparse expert method that integrates token-level dynamic expert routing, adaptive expert pool management, and a fusion strategy guided by both confidence and performance gain. Meanwhile, regularization losses are designed to encourage sparse and diverse expert activation for improved efficiency. Our extensive experimental evaluation on six public datasets demonstrates the effectiveness and efficiency of Token-Fusion in handling heterogeneous matching tasks, establishing it as a promising solution for unified and scalable multi-task data matching.
